bibliographic.title: Bubble Bot
bibliographic.author: Shanique Thompson
bibliographic.description:
Step into the world of Bubble Bot, a quirky experimental robot with a unique talent—creating bubble-based gadgets! Join Bubble Bot on an adventure at it harnesses its bubbly abilities to navigate challenges, escape confinement, and discover what happiness truly means in a vast, mysterious world.

This short branching narrative adventure, crafted in Twine during the 2025 Global Game Jam, invites you to shape Bubble Bot's destiny. Will it find open a café in the mountains , find friendship, or something entirely unexpected? The choice is yours.
